description: 대구교통공사_자전거대여현황 [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대구교통공사. [ESG-Social] 본 데이터는 대구교통공사의 ESG 사회(Social) 분야 시민편의 및 운영정보 데이터로, 도시철도 1·2호선 각 역사에서 운영 중인 무료 자전거 대여 서비스의. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 대구교통공사. Its tags are 대구도시철도 자전거, Social, 디트로 무료자전거, 자전거 대여현황, 도시철도 자전거 이용. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-07-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
